local function Em(Sm,Hm,lm)local Xm,im=Sm*3.141592653589793*2,Hm*3.141592653589793;

local function Sm(Hm,lm,Xm)return{x=Hm.x+(lm.x-Hm.x)*Xm,y=Hm.y+(lm.y-Hm.y)*Xm,z=Hm.z+(lm.z-Hm.z)*Xm,u=Hm.u+(lm.u-Hm.u)*Xm,v=Hm.v+(lm.v-Hm.v)*Xm,n=Hm.n:Lerp(lm.n,Xm).Unit};
end;

end;

local function im(Jm,Pm,gm,Im,Um)local Tm={};

end;

end;
if Xm~=Pm then if math.abs(Jm-qm)>1.0E-7 then Tm[#Tm+1]=Sm(bm,vm,Jm/(Jm-qm));
end;
end;
end;
return Tm;
end;
local function Xm(Jm,Pm)local gm=0;

Jm=im(Tm,gm,qm,false,Im);

end;
Tm=im(Tm,gm,qm,true,Im);

end;
end;
return Um;
end;

ec=w==1 and lc.BorderHi or lc.Accent;
R.bind(_,{ec.R,ec.G,ec.B},function(t)if type(t)~="table"then return;
end;
local _,f,E=tonumber(t[1]),tonumber(t[2]),tonumber(t[3]);
if _ then if f then if E then if _~=_ then return;
elseif f~=f then return;
elseif E~=E then return;
end;
else return;
end;
else return;
end;
else return;
end;
pc(w,Color3.new(math.clamp(_,0,1),math.clamp(f,0,1),math.clamp(E,0,1)));
end,15);
end;
R.finish();
e();
local function t()if Hc.Enabled then if vc.Visible then if yc.Visible then return;
end;
end;
end;
Oc();
for _,_ in ipairs(Hc:GetChildren())do if _:IsA("GuiObject")then if _:GetAttribute("NeptuneTransient")then _.Visible=false;
end;
end;
end;
end;
C.connect(Hc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"),t);
C.connect(vc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),t);
C.connect(yc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),t);
end;
end;
end;
end

local function stub(name)
	local mt={}
	mt.__index=function(t,k)
		if k=="enabled" or k=="on" or k=="active" or k=="Inverse" then return false end
		local s=stub(name.."."..tostring(k)) rawset(t,k,s) return s
	end
	mt.__call=function() return nil end
	return setmetatable({},mt)
end
